statement: A lower bound on the Z_p-corank of Sel_{p^infinity}(E/Q) does not imply the same lower bound on rank E(Q), because the p-primary Tate-Shafarevich group can contribute to Selmer corank. Root-faithful extraction requires Sha(E/Q)[p^infinity] finiteness/corank zero or another theorem eliminating the same kernel.
source_witness: Jetchev-Lauter-Stein, arXiv:0707.0032v1, Introduction and Corollary 3.5 context.
not_a_local_failure: This obstruction is downstream of the scoped Kolyvagin-to-Selmer relation and must be tracked separately from failure to find the direct complex-second-derivative arithmetic object.
repair_obligations: prove Sha[p^infinity] corank zero/finiteness from strictly weaker input than BSD rank
or construct two independent global Mordell-Weil points directly from the carrier
then separately obtain a compatible rank upper bound and full leading-term factors
